headline: World Humanoid Robot Games: Chinese humanoid robot breaks Usain Bolt's record, runs 100 meters in just 9.39 seconds
summary: A humanoid robot built by Chinese company Tianzhuo ran 100 metres in 9.39 seconds at the World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing, beating Usain Bolt's human record.
why: Humanoid robotics is a growing area of artificial intelligence and automation investment, with China pursuing industrial robot deployment as a strategic priority.
